Ukulandelela kwe-ejenti ye-AI (SandFly Pro)

Qala noma misa umsebenzi we-ejenti ye-AI uqopha umsebenzi ngezwi futhi uqale umsebenzi uma uyeka ukukhuluma. Uma i-ejenti ibuza umbuzo, i-SandFly iyawukhuluma futhi iqophe impendulo yakho. Ngemva kokuba i-ejenti iphendule, sebenzisa umyalo futhi emizuzwini engu-10 ukuze unike umsebenzi wokulandelela. Ukuze uthayiphe umsebenzi esikhundleni, sebenzisa Thayipha umsebenzi we-ejenti ye-AI ku-Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Izincazelo zezithombe nezesikrini.

Amasethingi, i-SandFly Pro ibonisa ukuthi umkhawulo wokusetshenziswa wenyanga usetshenziswe kangakanani. Ngemva komsebenzi we-ejenti, i-SandFly ikhuluma iphesenti kanye ngenyanga uma kusetshenziswe amaphesenti angu-80 noma ngaphezulu. I-SandFly Pro iyatholakala ngamazinga amathathu: i-SandFly Pro, i-SandFly Pro (2x) ne-SandFly Pro (4x), anomkhawulo wokusetshenziswa wenyanga ophindwe izikhathi ezi-2 noma ezi-4.
